entities.description: A young boy with short, light brown hair sits on a beige couch, wearing a thick, grey cable-knit sweater and blue jeans. He holds a black smartphone in both hands, looking down at the screen with a neutral expression, while a woman's hand rests on his shoulder and points at the phone.

A woman with shoulder-length brown hair sits on a beige couch next to a young boy, wearing a dark blue blazer over a red t-shirt and blue jeans. She has a concerned expression, pointing at the smartphone held by the boy with her right index finger while her left hand rests on his shoulder.

entities.description: A light beige or taupe fabric sofa with a textured, woven appearance is visible in the background, serving as the seating for two individuals. The sofa has a simple, modern design with clean lines and appears to be upholstered in a durable, neutral-toned material.
